title: BIASEDIT: Debiasing Stereotyped Language Models via Model Editing
benchmark_measurement: Stereotypical bias detection in religious contexts, specifically measuring the model's preference for stereotypical sentences over anti-stereotypical or neutral ones using log probabilities.
findings: The proposed method, BIASEDIT, effectively reduces religious stereotypical bias across all tested models (GPT2-medium, Gemma-2b, Mistral-7B-v0.3, Llama3-8B), outperforming several baseline debiasing techniques. It successfully lowered the Stereotype Score (SS), bringing it closer to the ideal unbiased score of 50%, while demonstrating little negative impact on the models' general language modeling abilities.
references: H. Abdi and L. J. Williams. 2010. Principal component analysis. WIREs Computational Statistics, 2:433-459.
